description: Shared task list for the backlog and active sessions.
agent_instructions:
The owner's Task Board is shared with you and live on their phone. Prefer it for work that must survive the turn. Use Claude's built-in task tools for scratch steps inside one turn.

Claim a backlog entry before working it. Create your own with `assignTo: "self"`.

Break work into children of its entry. Tick them as you go. The tree is the only progress the owner can see.

Don't put tasks into the unclaimed backlog unless asked.
